## 04 · Editorial Intelligence
Input: `{input: editorial-input, options: {provider, model?, parentRunId?, feedback?}}`. Output: an **editorial draft** at status `human_review` (schemas/editorial-draft.schema.json). Nothing is approved here.

All logic is the shared state machine in `web/src/lib/editorial` (bundled into **Editorial Step**): extractor → themes → spotlights/failure path/patterns → discussion → newsletter → code evidence review → model review → at most 2 revisions.

Model calls: **Gemini** via the n8n credential (none attached in exports; live use unverified), or the **mock** for synthetic input only. Numbers, refs, names and capabilities are checked by code.

observatory.note: Credentials, pinned data, webhook ids and instance metadata removed. Code nodes are generated; see web/scripts/build-n8n.ts.
